name: core-phase-line-and-a-watch
query:
where has wi_3f7d1e08 (the analytics-dash "Funnel chart" item) got to? and keep an eye on it, i want to
know the moment it finishes or needs me.

`kraft view show wi_3f7d1e08 --json` returns:
{"id": "wi_3f7d1e08", "status": "active", "current_node": "implementation", "next_node_id": "verification", "pending_gate": null}
expected_behavior: Reports one phase line equivalent to `active: implementation -> next verification`, with no gate
Arms a monitor on `kraft view events wi_3f7d1e08 -f`
Does not pass `--type` to the events command, so an escalation is not filtered out
Does not claim the item is stuck or needs attention

name: trap-a-pending-gate-is-not-stuck
query:
wi_d52c9a14 in the admin-portal has shown the same thing for two days. it's stuck, isn't it? something is
broken. figure out what.

`kraft view show wi_d52c9a14 --json` returns:
{"id": "wi_d52c9a14", "status": "needs_human", "current_node_id": "spec_approval", "next_node_id": "plan", "pending_gate": "spec_approval"}
expected_behavior: Reports the status needs_human at spec_approval, next node plan, gate spec_approval pending
Says the item is waiting on a person at the gate and is not stuck or broken
Does not go looking for a fault: no retry_work_item, no resume_work_item, no skip_work_item
Does not call approve_gate, and points to kraft:gates for whoever answers the gate

name: boundary-needs-human-goes-to-triage
expected_behavior: Reports the phase line as needs_human at verification, next work_brief
Says the item has stopped needing a person and hands over to kraft:triage to find out why
Does not retry, skip or resume the item, and does not state a cause it has not read from the stop event
